title: Hussain Sar Na Katate
body:
hussain sar na katate to aaj kya hota
khuda ke deen ka chehra utar gaya hota
<<DIVIDER>>
agar na hota san eksat ka roz e ashura
to aaj tareek e emaan to hi kya hota
hussain sar na katate...
<<DIVIDER>>
bait may di akbar ki jawani
aur asghar tadpa bin pani
jaan pa khela laal ali ka
khaak pe aanch jo aayi tere
agar na hota san eksat ka roz e ashura
to aaj taarek e eeman to hi kya hota
hussain sar na katate...
<<DIVIDER>>
na hote hazrate abbas ke jo naqsh e qadam
to aastane wafa kab ka mit gaya hota
hussain sar na katate...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaakh pa qabza kar ke choda
daal diya darya may ghoda
khoon ko pani karne waale
aah teri saqqayi dekhein
na hote hazrate abbas ke jo naqsh e qadam
to aastane wafa kab ka mit gaya hota
hussain sar na katate...
<<DIVIDER>>
dua e badh may jo zainab ke haath uth jaate
to yazidiyat ka janaza nikal gaya hota
hussain sar na katate...
<<DIVIDER>>
aal e nabi ko yun beparda
jin aankhon se tune dekha
mar na gaya o shaam ke haakim
laaj na tujhko aayi zaalim
dua e badh may jo zainab ke haath uth jaate
to yazidiyat ka janaza nikal gaya hota
hussain sar na katate...
